intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Tavri unrolls a hand-drawn map of the palace. Every corridor has a joke written beside it.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “This corridor is labeled *certain doom.* It leads to a linen cupboard.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Anonymously. With my name on the back, in case it got popular.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Here’s the stair that ate a duke’s dignity. And here’s where the laundry staff nap.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The nap spot is marked with a tiny, very accurate drawing of three people asleep on folded towels.

options.labelText: “It’s great. Maybe ask the laundry before you publish their nap spot?”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Oh. That’s their one hiding place, isn’t it?”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Private edition for the laundry, then. *Certain doom* stays.”

options.labelText: “This is brilliant. Copy it and hang one in every corridor.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She looks delighted for exactly as long as it takes to find the nap spot.

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She rolls the map up tight and tucks it away.
